corrective_action.required_behavior: All successor validation of the closed v0.13.5 run must use direct read-only marker-last candidate validation and must never acquire a writable EvidenceStore session or rebuild its derived results projection.
verification_requirements: old-root complete file-byte manifest is identical before and after successor topology validation
old results.json last-write timestamp is identical before and after successor topology validation
tests fail if read_committed, rebuild_results, or any old-root write path is invoked
score-free topology is separated from post-terminal efficacy materialization

derived_projection.role: Derived EvidenceStore projection reconstructed from immutable marker-last attempt candidates; it is not a primary attempt artifact.

finding: A preauthorization private-evidence test called EvidenceStore.read_committed through the successor topology helper. read_committed rebuilt and atomically replaced the old run's derived results.json even though its bytes were unchanged. This violated the intended read-only access boundary and was detected before any v0.13.6 authorization or model call.

trigger.command_class: offline pytest using the host-only private_old_state fixture
